comment_regular_data.body:
I like the direction this is going in. A couple suggestions to further improve the readability:

1. No empty params `()`, as they don't seem to serve any obvious purpose
2. Make one or the other implicit. e.g. Any parameter that isn't marked as non-nullable is nullable by default (or vice-versa).

> I like the direction this is going in. A couple suggestions to further improve the readability:
> 
> 1. No empty params `()`, as they don't seem to serve any obvious purpose

Not possible in one PR, but yes, I want that in the end. In the current PR, we need to briefly support both locations and thus need the ().

> 2. Make one or the other implicit. e.g. Any parameter that isn't marked as non-nullable is nullable by default (or vice-versa).

I'm not a fan of this request. I want to align with https://clang.llvm.org/docs/analyzer/developer-docs/nullability.html so that we can use the static analysis being developed there.

commit.message:
refactor: Use per-parameter nullability annotations.

This is less error-prone.
